# Stable forcing baseline: issues 290–294

Scope: v4 main `c242756efd0329bea38427823b7f07fd0354ee40`, with the catalog foundation in `577095aa`. The user authorized a combined implementation, qualification and integration goal. The separate v5 checkout is untouched. MATLAB retains backward compatibility; the unused C++ source API may change.

## Delivered behavior

- Explicit antialiasing on constant hydrostatic/nonhydrostatic and Barotropic QG transforms, with persisted `Nj`, prepared radial/vertical masks, spectral priority 127, amplitude preservation and double-antialias rejection.
- Horizontal/vertical damping and vertical diffusivity on constant stratification, retaining MATLAB spatial stages, configured parameters, wave/geostrophic coupling and reference-time phase. Diagonal modal field operators avoid extra FFTs, physical workspaces and dense matrices. The mean-density-anomaly option is preserved and naturally inert for constant stratification. Barotropic QG rejects these closures.
- Constant-stratification narrow-band forcing uses its exact class/version and canonical persisted selected coefficients through the fixed-amplitude implementation.
- Factory preparation now shares the effective resolution needed by adaptive damping, pseudo-topographic damping avoidance and CFL selection. MATLAB recognizes the explicit closure by its `antialias filter` registry name on constant stratification; Barotropic QG uses its geometry's resolution. Prepared calls use no class-name dispatch.
- Corrected the existing adaptive-damping barotropic term for configurations retaining at most two vertical modes. The prior C++ operator omitted this MATLAB term.
- The shared forcing slice contains 72 rows: 61 supported and 11 intentional incompatibilities. MATLAB construction/attachment owns scientific classification. Numerical tests consume every applicable row; C++ tests exercise every incompatible row. Schema/validator checks reject omitted, duplicate, contradictory, unresolved and unproven records. Pending acceptance cannot satisfy completeness.
- MATLAB production changes only add four portable capability hooks. Constructors, required-property lists, scientific evaluation, old-file loading and property-only save formats are unchanged. Generated website content is unchanged.

## Verification ledger

- `TestPortableStableForcing`: all nine methods pass. The first eight passed together; the subsequently added adaptive RK78/CFL method passed separately. Both reference and native FFTW providers were exercised. Coverage includes all 61 isolated exact pairs and appended MATLAB trajectories; odd/even grids; zero/nonzero viscosity/diffusivity; both mean-density flags; explicit retained counts 0, 1 and 3; ordering/fixed amplitudes; converted resolution; segmented versus uninterrupted RK4; adaptive RK78 and effective CFL resolution; and four malformed append targets remaining byte-for-byte unchanged.
- Native prepared RHS evaluation reports zero application C++ allocations in the MATLAB-generated cases. The direct reference FFT intentionally allocates per-line scratch; it is a numerical reference, not the allocation gate. Vendor-internal allocation is outside this probe.
- MATLAB forcing contracts and catalog checks passed 11/11, including deterministic regeneration. The four catalog tests passed again after adding exact adaptive/narrow-band evidence references. The new test's three small schedule-growth analyzer messages were explicitly annotated; its final Code Analyzer run reports zero messages.
- Existing MATLAB `TestForcingLifecycle` and `TestForcingMathematicalContracts` passed 13/13, including scientific formulas, registry ordering, NetCDF restoration, resolution conversion, variable-stratification mean-density ownership and SQG diffusivity behavior. No changes were made to their implementation or assertions.
- `TestCompiledKernelIntegration` passed 5/5 with updated source hashes. New/modified catalog tools report zero analyzer messages. The modified older contract test retains three pre-existing property-name hints, and `WVAntialiasing` retains five pre-existing unused-input hints; no production correctness findings were introduced.
- Native AppleClang Release runtime CTest: 33/35 passed initially. The two failures were stale catalog availability and a pre-existing test that assumed native FFTW was unavailable even in a native-enabled build. The regenerated catalog and provider-aware test passed their focused rerun, along with the expanded forcing dispatch source policy. All 35 tests are covered by these passing results.
- New C++ closure tests pass scalar validation, missing/nonfinite/negative/fractional parameters, logical flags, double-antialias rejection, filter-only amplitude preservation, analytical equal-rate modal decay and negative energy tendency. The analytical identity uses MATLAB's modal-normalization gravity, 9.81.
- AddressSanitizer + UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer: forcing/RK4, checkpoint reader, Barotropic QG forcing and catalog/rejection tests pass. An initial multi-target Make invocation regenerated CMake but did not yet expose the newly added target to that invocation; its subsequent build succeeded.
- GCC 14.2 compiled the runtime libraries and four standalone forcing/checkpoint/catalog tests with warnings-as-errors; all four tests pass. The full local GCC runner build is limited by incompatible Apple Mach SDK headers. The standalone tests use the configured current SDK and bypass only that unrelated CLI build dependency. macOS linker deployment-version warnings remain; full Linux runner qualification is delegated to repository CI.
- ATS main `511aa6af9c60353b3de4d371dfe0df43159027cf`, rebuilt against this worktree, passed 7/7 including its source-linked runner end-to-end test. ATS remains clean.
- Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema validates the 72-row complete slice. `docs:check` passed: 2026 files, 4145 routes, zero differences. Whitespace and scope review passed; no package manifests, released snapshots, generated website files or tracked binaries were changed. Required task assets were available.

Initial MATLAB runs exposed fixture setup mistakes: path contamination from the separate v5 checkout, unscheduled lazy output, and an attempted write to read-only priority. Those were corrected in the test setup. Subsequent numerical failures identified the two adaptive-damping interactions described above; the implementations were corrected without loosening numerical tolerances. A reference-provider allocation assertion was narrowed to the production native provider after confirming the reference FFT's intentional scratch allocations.

## Integration and handoff

Publish this branch through the repository's required checks and merge into v4 main. Close #290–#294 only after integration. No hosted checks or merge are claimed by this pre-publication ledger.

#297 extends this same catalog and forcing contracts to Stratified QG runtime execution. Its vertical diffusivity path still needs the verified equivalent of `-f*kappa_z*diffZG(eta,n=3)`; the mean-density-anomaly source remains absent for SQG. Horizontal/vertical damping remain intentional PV incompatibilities. Later hydrostatic/nonhydrostatic variable-stratification goals own their persisted modal operators and nonzero mean-density-anomaly source. #306 assembles feature slices and owns the final complete-runtime support/publication decision. Thermal damping stays excluded while MATLAB documents it as under development.
